text:
maria: quick heads-up — I'm kicking off an RFC thread for adding "signal enrichment" to SLO alert payloads so the Console can do smarter routing and quieter notifications. want eng-platform + eng-sre eyes.

sam: +1. can you list the main goals? is this about adding metadata to alert webhooks or a new notify API?

maria: main goals: 1) reduce noisy pages by surfacing local context (recent error bursts, noisy-key heuristics, tenant impact), 2) let Console show a realtime preview of which route/quota would win, 3) keep payloads small and optional. thinking minimal schema extension to current SLO notify payload.

talia: high level sounds great. big ops concerns: payload size (we add these to every sample?) and trustworthiness — we shouldn't route purely on client-side heuristics without server-side guardrails.

ben: proposal sketch: extend notify payload with optional "enrichment" block that contains:
```
{
  "enrichment_version": "v1",
  "recent_error_rate": "5m:4.2%",
  "burst_windows": ["1m:120", "5m:300"],
  "noisy_key_score": 0.73,
  "tenant_score": "low/med/high"
}
```
only included when generated from the signal pipeline (configurable sampling). default: off.

sam: nice. how do we calculate noisy_key_score? is that expensive?

ben: simple heuristic in the aggregator: entropy on key distribution + moving-average of per-key spike frequency. cheap-ish when piggybacked on existing aggregation. can be gated behind sampling for high-volume tenants.

maria: console UX asks: can we also include the evaluation that explains why the Console would choose route A vs B? e.g., reason: "tenant_quota_exhausted" or "soft_threshold_hit" so we can show an inline explain.

ben: we can add a small "decision_hints" array with short tokenized reasons (<= 64 chars each). keeps it compact.

rollout-bot: deploy job #8821 finished: signal-aggregator v2 -> staging :rocket:

talia: operational ask: add a TTL to enrichment metadata. if Console shows stale bursts it will be confusing. suggest include "sample_ts" and "ttl_seconds" fields.

ben: agreed. example augmented payload snippet:
```
{ "enrichment_version":"v1", "sample_ts":"1735557990", "ttl_seconds":120, "recent_error_rate":"1m:6.1%", "decision_hints":["quiet_score_high","tenant_quota_low"] }
```

sam: API compatibility question — do we add this to the existing notify endpoint or create /notify/v2? we want a path that doesn't break older consoles and SDKs.

maria: prefer adding optional top-level "enrichment" key to current payload (backwards compatible). but we should version the field clearly and publish a small contract doc. fallback: if enrichment present, Console may use it; otherwise behavior unchanged.

talia: can we add a sampling header so downstream partners know this was sampled? helps for audits.

ben: will add "enrichment_sampling": {"rate":"0.01","reason":"high-volume"} meta.

sam: one more: telemetry — we need metrics for enrichment coverage + false positives where enrichment would have changed route vs actual route taken. can Console emit a lightweight ack back to signal pipeline?

maria: rather than ack, how about Console posts a small telemetry ping to our /telemetry endpoint with route_chosen and enrichment_used boolean. that keeps core pipeline one-way.

ben: ok. I'll draft the payload schema PR and a migration plan:
- opt-in sampling rollout (0.1% -> 1% -> 10%)
- add ttl and versioning
- Console telemetry pings for evaluation

maria: action items:
- ben: PR for schema + aggregator sampling hooks (due EOD Thu)
- sam: outline Console preview UX (inputs we need) by Tue
- talia: ops runbook addendum for enrichment (limits/kill-switch) by Wed

maria: thanks all. tagging @eng-onsla for visibility. :eyes:
